Predicting how molecular changes affect large-scale brain activity is a difficult task because of the lack of appropriate methods to link scales. In this perspective, we review a class of mean-field models that can integrate biophysical details such as synaptic receptors or membrane ion channels. This leads to a multi-scale modeling approach that can be used to evaluate how microscopic changes can impact macroscopic brain activity.
